skin.note: Shift the sampled ochre towards olive for exposed skin.

ear lining.note: Warm inset on the forward surface of the pinna.

socket.note: Recess below the brow, nostrils and the split between jaws.

eyes.note: Keep a bright patch in the shadow of the brow.

snout.note: Warmer end of the projecting nose.

tusk.note: Sampled ivory on the paired lower canines.

rag.note: Rust cloth below the dark belt.

rag fold.note: Deep pleat where two strips meet.

leather.note: Sampled leather on the belt and arm bindings.

iron.note: Dull plate with a cool shadow next to the skin.

heartwood.note: Light exposed grain of the broad striking end.

bark.note: Dark facets around the wooden core.

hoop.note: Dark iron rings cross the long grain.

grip.note: Narrow leather-wound haft in the fist.

brow ridge.note: Shade the slanted brow above each bright eye.
